item_short_desc: Rothco's Lightweight Tactical BDU Shorts are versatile, comfortable and breathable with 100% cotton material.
description: Rothco's Lightweight Tactical BDU Shorts are versatile, comfortable and breathable with 100% cotton material. Adjustable waist tabs with a hook and loop design allow for perfect fit. These tactical shorts have plenty of storage with two front slash pockets, two lower bellowed cargo pockets and two back pockets with flap and button closure.
